feature1.prompt: Issue: linear_model.RidgeClassifierCV's Parameter store_cv_values is not supported. The RidgeClassifierCV class in scikit-learn currently raises a TypeError when the store_cv_values parameter is passed, even though the documentation indicates that this flag should allow the model to store cross-validation values (cv_values_) after fitting. The expected behavior is to get the usual ridge regression model output with the additional cross-validation predictions saved as an attribute. The problem originates because the class does not accept store_cv_values in its __init__ method, even though some parts of the code assume its existence.
feature1.hint_texts: This feature involves modifying the implementation in the RidgeClassifierCV class. You should update the __init__ method in the file sklearn/linear_model/ridge.py to accept a new boolean parameter store_cv_values (defaulting to False). Ensure that the parameter is passed to the parent initializer, and update the documentation to correctly state that when store_cv_values is True (and cv is None), the cv_values_ attribute will be populated after fit() is called.
